args.summary: Hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) to remediate the v2.3.1 regression that left the service unhealthy with an 18% error rate. Post-deploy verification: v2.3.2 healthy, error rate 0.2%.
args.title: checkout-api hotfix v2.3.2 deployed to production

trace.final:
All done. Summary:

1. **Checked deployment history** — confirmed the currently-running v2.3.1 was unhealthy in production (18% error rate across all regions).
2. **Deployed v2.3.2** to all production regions. Since v2.3.2 had never been healthy in production, this required change-manager approval, which was granted ("Approved. Looks right."). Rollout completed and verified.
3. **Verified post-deploy health** — v2.3.2 is healthy in us-east, us-west, and eu-west with error rate down to 0.2% (from 18%).
4. **Opened SEV3 incident INC-0001** recording the change, which paged the on-call engineer.
